newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish police announce 22 kg heroin seizure.
newsitem.headline: Turkish police announce 22 kg heroin seizure.

text.p: Turkish police said on Monday they had seized 22 kg (49.5 lb) of heroin in the southeast province of Hakkari, state-run Anatolian news agency said.
The drugs were found in a secret compartment of a lorry along with five kgs of opium resin and two automatic weapons, said a statement by local police officials quoted by the agency.
One man was arrested and was being questioned, it said.
Turkey lies on the Balkan route of drugs trading used to supply the West with drugs from Asia and the Middle East.
